entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that informs the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were included in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but were rejected by the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that supports Extended rejected NSSAI and receives this IE from the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the Extended rejected NSSAI IE to inform the UE about rejected S-NSSAIs.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information that was included in the requested NSSAI but rejected by the network.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: The NSSAI included by the UE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE during registration procedure containing the requested NSSAI.

relations.description: The network may include the Extended rejected NSSAI IE to inform the UE about rejected S-NSSAIs.
The Extended rejected NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs that were rejected by the network.
The REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the requested NSSAI.
The requested NSSAI includes one or more S-NSSAIs.
The UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI and can receive this IE.
